scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: Let’s go to an izakaya! It’s nice to enjoy a grown-up vibe and have a relaxed conversation.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: An izakaya?♪ That sounds so mature!

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: They went to a nearby izakaya and sat at a quiet table. Surrounded by a calm atmosphere, they ordered drinks.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: Can you drink, Megumi?

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Just a little♪ I like cocktails.

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: Their drinks arrived, and they toasted. As the alcohol kicked in, their conversation grew more lively.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: {{playerName}}-senpai, you usually seem cool, but you’re actually very kind♪

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: Is she getting tipsy? She seems more relaxed than usual, which helps me loosen up too.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: You're always cheerful, Megumi. It’s fun being with you.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Ehehe♪ Thank you. I had a really great time today.

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: As the mood lightened, a complimentary dish was brought to their table.

scenarios.speaker: Server
scenarios.text: Here’s a little appetizer on the house~

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: Wait a minute... That voice... Could it be...?

scenarios.speaker: Hgon
scenarios.text: Oh! {{playerName}}-senpai and Megumi-chan!

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Hgon-kun!? You work here part-time?

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: So you're working here? Thanks!!

scenarios.speaker: Hgon
scenarios.text: Yep! Gotta save up some money... Enjoy your meal, you two♪

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: Hgon went back to attending other customers. Grateful for the service, the two returned to their pleasant conversation.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Thanks to Hgon-kun, I feel all warm and fuzzy now♪ By the way, {{playerName}}-senpai... If I win the M1GP, let’s go on a reward trip together!

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: Maybe it's the alcohol talking... But still, Megumi’s inviting me on a trip? That’s awesome!

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: That’s a great idea! Let’s do it!

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Yay♪ So, {{playerName}}-senpai, where would you like to go?

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: Where would you like to travel to?

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Yay♪ It’s a promise! I’ll win the M1GP and go on that trip with you, {{playerName}}-senpai!

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: Seeing Megumi-chan so happy... I need to do my best and support her properly.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: It's a promise! As your mentor, I’ll do everything I can to help you win.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Thank you♪ With you by my side, {{playerName}}-senpai, I know we can build a great app!

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: With the help of a little alcohol and Hgon’s surprise appearance, their bond grew even stronger. Now united by their goal of winning the M1GP and going on a trip, their hearts move forward together...

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: Time passed, and the day of the lab trip and M1GP presentation finally arrived...
